C1848.title: Freight Drivers Used Location Spoofing to Fake Routes and Defraud Freight Fees
keywords: Freight Drivers Used Location Spoofing to Fake Routes and Defraud Freight Fees
C1848.summary: In April 2022, Xinmin Evening News reported a Shanghai police case in which freight drivers used software to modify location data and disguise driving routes. The suspects created false transportation records through self-placed and self-accepted orders, brushing orders to obtain platform freight subsidies at a million-yuan scale. The case illustrates settlement fraud after route traces and transport records are falsified.

references.title: Freight drivers used software to modify locations, disguise routes, place and accept their own orders, and brush orders for million-yuan gains - Xinmin Evening News
